# Release Notes

Version 2 is planned to expand the protocol beyond the current `Ping` message with additional message types, more explicit encoding and decoding rules, and stronger validation so unknown or malformed payloads can be handled predictably while preserving compatibility with existing ping round trips.

Shipped: v2 `Hello` message support, encoded as `v:2|hello:<name>`.
